scope: Bounded read-only local owner API audit of individual factual prefix cuts within true B4. No RPC, model, CUDA, backward, optimizer, checkpoint, benchmark, candidate, adapter, mask change or production edit.
decision: The current DT path does not already expose an exact per-row-prefix-cut B4 layout. Native HF supplies useful state, position and varlen components, but the current lease, runner and finite-FA ABI cannot represent the proposed interior K/V holes plus per-row query logical offsets. No implementation or new blocking requirement follows from this audit.

representation_under_review.notation: Each row has factual cut p_i and valid suffix length s_i; P=max(p_i), S=max(s_i).
representation_under_review.physical_KV_layout: Valid factual K/V at [0,p_i), an invalid gap [p_i,P), then current suffix at physical [P,P+s_i), followed by invalid end padding.
representation_under_review.logical_query_positions: Suffix query j must retain original logical/RoPE position p_i+j, not P+j.
representation_under_review.required_causality: After removing invalid keys/queries, query j must see factual keys 0..p_i-1 and suffix keys 0..j.
representation_under_review.scope: This is the parent-specified idea being audited, not a proposed implementation or accepted runtime layout.

native_owner_support.supported: Explicit per-row 2D position_ids are accepted and expanded for text/multimodal RoPE. Without explicit IDs, the model takes one cache.get_seq_length() offset for the rectangular batch.
native_owner_support.implication: Per-row logical RoPE coordinates are representable by the original model API; the current runner does not supply them.

native_owner_support.supported: Cached K/V is combined by the original Cache.update, then the configured attention interface receives the mask. Cached keys are already rotated before update.
native_owner_support.limitation: The update call does not forward per-row cache_position indices. Supplying a cache_position kwarg alone would not turn this DynamicCache append into per-row insertion.

native_owner_support.supported: Original DynamicLayer.update concatenates K/V on the shared sequence dimension; it can store a rectangular padded tensor.
native_owner_support.limitation: Its stored physical width is not a per-row valid-length vector; no row-specific insertion or mask is created by this append method.

native_owner_support.supported: Hybrid DynamicCache.get_seq_length selects an attention layer and returns that layer sequence length; linear-state layers do not track sequence length.
native_owner_support.limitation: This is one cache length, not p_i for each row.

native_owner_support.supported: The saved original FA owner uses all nonzero key-mask indices, separately unpads the final query_length mask slice, and calls the public varlen function.
native_owner_support.implication: Original native FA has machinery to remove interior masked K/V and construct distinct q/k lengths without per-row B1 calls.
native_owner_support.limit: This does not establish the current finite-FA contract or certify this untested hybrid cache layout.

native_owner_support.supported: The native text model accepts an attention-mask mapping keyed by full_attention and linear_attention.
native_owner_support.limit: The exact current masking_utils implementation was not present in the bounded saved source set; this audit does not assert what its default recurrent-mask helper does for cached interior-gap layouts.

native_owner_support.supported: Original GDN accepts batched conv/recurrent initial-state tensors; those fixed-size state tensors need not encode an absolute sequence position.
native_owner_support.implication: Stacking already captured per-row states at their own valid cut is representable as state data. The current compose/lease chooses the same cut for every row.

current_DT_contract_gaps.gap: prepare_native_prefix_leases chooses min(start)//64*64 once per original B4, records needed boundaries at that shared length, and constructs one lease with that scalar.

compose_native_prefix_cache and NativePrefixLease accept one prefix_length; factual IDs must have exactly that common width, all GDN states use that boundary, and all FA rows use [:prefix_length]. There is no per-row lengths/mask return channel.

Validated attribute requires all-one equal-length endpoint masks, chooses one prefix_start, slices the whole batch and targets by that scalar, constructs one query_start, and requires native_dense=1/native_varlen=0 for FA.

RightPaddedLengths supports a per-row terminal valid length and optional coefficient output start, but query_start is a single int. The finite operation takes contiguous K/V and one shared query offset; it has no interior key-mask or per-row query-offset argument. Coefficient starts restrict output positions, not which history keys are attended.
Packed targets retain per-target positions, but the existing suffix rebasing method accepts one integer start and one resulting rectangular activation extent. No current row-specific rebase is wired.
Current passive GDN capture rejects cu_seq_lens_q and requires the captured FLA stage cu_seqlens=None. Native packed FLA availability is not a supported finite-GDN varlen path.
Original finite-FLA adjoint calls pass cu_seqlens=None; suffix slice start is one int. Its documented padding is only the final 64-token tile, not a validated variable-length model-mask contract.

GDN_padding_semantics.finding: GDN does not expose a generic freeze-state-on-padding operation here. A supplied 2D mask zeros input hidden states; conv and gated recurrence still advance. In particular g=-exp(A_log)*softplus(a+dt_bias) remains a recurrence decay even for a zero hidden input.
GDN_padding_semantics.left_padding: Inserting masked positions before a valid suffix can advance conv/recurrent state before that suffix and therefore is not established equivalent to resuming at its factual cut.
GDN_padding_semantics.right_padding: Causality keeps later padding from changing earlier valid outputs, but the final cache after padded steps is generally different from the cache at the last valid step. This is not the same as saying end padding is ignored.
GDN_padding_semantics.important_scope: A batched per-row initial state with right-padded suffixes is not ruled out mathematically. The current dense finite path has not implemented or accepted its masks, target rebasing and finite-FA geometry. No adapter is invented in this review.

measured_opportunity_scope: The existing old88-request calculation gives a possible dense B4 suffix-slot reduction of31.01%/27.43% with row-specific 64-aligned cuts. It is not current full-iteration work, FLOPs, speed, a proven compatible implementation or a deployment recommendation.
limits: Local prefix candidate4a/lease6d were not used as the active06f/d5 ABI; exact baseline Git bytes were read instead.

The current HF model59f9 and DT runner/GDN sources are bound to current native-convolution receipts. Cache/FA utility bodies are cited from existing installed-owner receipts with their original hash; no fresh runtime utility import/hash is asserted.
No new causal mask, state transition, attention operator, finite formula, reference policy, credit definition or numerical tolerance is introduced.
The key gap is representational in the current finite-FA and common-cut contracts, not proof that exact native B4 reuse is impossible or that31% slot reduction gives31% wall-time savings.
No B1 substitution, full root tape, rejected sorting proposal or unmeasured all-weights-resident policy is proposed.
